title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: Current motion doesn't read coherently — particles move without intention. FIX: replace whatever motion exists with ONE clearly-readable physical or narrative law. Pick one: gravity (everything falls), wind from one direction (unidirectional drift), tidal in-out (radial breathing), spiral attractor pull, or a directed signal-propagation (impulse from one point spreading). Whichever is chosen, the viewer must be able to NAME the law in 5 seconds. No more 'general agitation.'

manfred_mohr.praise: Clean unidirectional wind vector is computable law — viewer can NAME it.
manfred_mohr.concern: Catenary sag is decorative naturalism, not geometric transformation. The form references physics instead of pure structure.
manfred_mohr.directive: Remove catenary sag. Pinned endpoints at same Y. Wind displaces only by angle from horizontal — pure rotation parameter visible.

morakana.praise: Wind from west carries atmospheric weight — gloaming palette (0x08070a) holds twilight pressure. The law is readable as weather.
morakana.concern: Seven wires at arbitrary depths lack territorial stakes. This could be telephone lines anywhere — no sovereignty, border, or data commons.
morakana.directive: Give the wires geopolitical coordinates — lat/lon labels, or wire as data-transmission route. Wind becomes information flow, not decoration.

refik_anadol.praise: Gust envelope (slow swell, audio-reactive) creates memory-like breathing — the wind remembers its own rhythm across frames.
refik_anadol.concern: Seven wires at 60 nodes is museum-lobby miniature, not institutional scale. MoMA needs 200k+ particles, not 420 vertices total.
refik_anadol.directive: Multiply strand count to 140, nodes to 400 per strand. Same law, overwhelming density — wind moves through 56k points.

entangled_others.praise: Wind as biological signal (ripple travels downwind like nerve impulse) — the substrate is alive, not mechanical.
entangled_others.concern: Wires are human infrastructure (telephone, clothesline). The form centers human utility instead of letting non-human agency speak.
entangled_others.directive: Replace wires with mycelial hyphae or vascular roots. Same spring-chain, same wind — but organism responding to air current, not artifact.

casey_reas.praise: ONE deterministic law (unidirectional wind) governs all motion — no noise, no randomness. The restraint is correct.
casey_reas.concern: Audio-reactivity (bass * 4.0, level * 1.4) injects external noise that breaks the law's purity. Wind should be autonomous.
casey_reas.directive: Remove audio input entirely. Wind swell uses only time-based sines. The piece must be deterministic from T=0, no external disruption.
